title: 1.2 Plate Tectonics Theory
description: The lithosphere, asthenosphere, major plates, and the development of plate tectonic theory. Hard level.

questions.question: Which property of the asthenosphere best enables plate motion?
options: Its ductility, which allows slow flow
Its high density compared with the crust
Its solid iron composition
Its complete lack of heat
questions.correctAnswer: Its ductility, which allows slow flow

questions.question: How does plate tectonics affect atmospheric and oceanic chemistry?
options: It seals the atmosphere from the surface
It cycles material between the crust, mantle, oceans and atmosphere
It removes all gases from the oceans
It fixes the composition of rocks forever
questions.correctAnswer: It cycles material between the crust, mantle, oceans and atmosphere

questions.question: What follows from the fact that plates change size?
options: Continents become smaller every year
The Earth radius increases rapidly
Ocean basins can expand or shrink over geologic time
Ocean currents stop flowing
questions.correctAnswer: Ocean basins can expand or shrink over geologic time

questions.question: What distinguishes plate tectonics from earlier fixist views?
options: Continents are permanent
The mantle is molten throughout
Mountains form only from erosion
Lithospheric plates move laterally over a weaker layer
questions.correctAnswer: Lithospheric plates move laterally over a weaker layer

questions.question: Why is the theory useful for interpreting the rock record?
options: It explains rock ages and fossil distribution patterns
It names every mineral
It measures rainfall over centuries
It predicts the weather next week
questions.correctAnswer: It explains rock ages and fossil distribution patterns

questions.question: What does a motion of a few centimeters per year imply?
options: Plates cross oceans within a human lifetime
Large displacements accumulate over millions of years
Plates stop between glacial periods
Motion is too small to measure
questions.correctAnswer: Large displacements accumulate over millions of years

questions.question: Which evidence shows plate boundaries may cross ocean floors?
options: All plates match continent outlines
Ocean floors have no tectonic features
The North American Plate includes western North Atlantic seafloor
Plate edges are always on land
questions.correctAnswer: The North American Plate includes western North Atlantic seafloor

questions.question: What happens as plates move in different directions?
options: They dissolve into the mantle
They become stationary
They exchange ocean water
They interact at boundaries to form features such as mountains and earthquakes
questions.correctAnswer: They interact at boundaries to form features such as mountains and earthquakes

questions.question: What role does the lithosphere play in plate tectonics?
options: It is the rigid shell broken into moving plates
It is the liquid outer layer
It is the gaseous envelope
It is the deepest core layer
questions.correctAnswer: It is the rigid shell broken into moving plates

questions.question: How does plate tectonics shape environments for life?
options: It fixes all climates permanently
It drives long-term cycling of elements among Earth spheres
It removes nutrients from soils
It stops volcanic activity
questions.correctAnswer: It drives long-term cycling of elements among Earth spheres
